key.name: style
key.description: How a banner shows its app's color.

key.name: position
key.description: Corner or edge of the primary monitor where banners appear.

key.name: material
key.description: Solid fill, see-through fill, or see-through with the desktop behind blurred.

key.name: tone
key.description: Dark glass with light text, or light glass with dark text.

key.name: text-size
key.description: Size of the banner's app name, title and body.

key.name: width
key.description: Width of a banner in logical pixels.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of a banner in logical pixels.

key.name: entrance
key.description: How a banner arrives and leaves.

key.name: max-cards
key.description: Most banners on screen at once. A new one past this makes the oldest leave early; it stays in the notification list. 1 shows one banner at a time.

key.name: normal-timeout
key.description: Seconds a banner stays on screen. The countdown pauses while the pointer is on the stack and waits until the user is active.

key.name: critical-timeout
key.description: Seconds a critical banner stays on screen.

key.name: countdown
key.description: Whether each banner shows a line that shrinks as its time runs out.

key.name: rules
key.description: JSON list of rules, checked in order; the first match wins. Each has a name, case-insensitive regular expressions for the app name, title and body (empty matches anything), a hex color, and an action: show, silence (list only, no banner) or block.

key.name: rate-limit
key.description: Milliseconds after an app's banner during which further notifications from that app skip the banner and only go to the list. 0 turns this off.

key.name: group-by-app
key.description: Whether the notification list groups an app's notifications together. When off, each notification gets its own entry.

key.name: style-list
key.description: Whether entries in the date menu's notification list take the banners' look: app color, tone, material, text size and corner radius.
